prompts.neutral:

Asset type: reactive browser game face-mask character, neutral state master
Primary request: Create one original front-facing chibi cat head on a perfectly flat solid #00FF00 chroma-key background for later removal.
Input images: Image 1 is a finish, composition, scale, lighting, eye-size, and premium 2.5D plush-clay micro-fuzz reference only. Do not copy its bee anatomy, colors, stripes, wings, antennae, or silhouette.
Subject: An unmistakable unlabeled warm ginger tabby cat head only, with a very broad rounded chibi face, two pointed triangular ears with soft pink inner fur, subtle feline cheek ruff, three restrained darker ginger forehead tabby markings, compact cream muzzle pads, a small inverted pink triangular nose, whisker dots and three short crisp dark whiskers per cheek, warm blush, and giant honey-brown glossy eyes with a subtly feline almond-round shape. Lighting/mood: soft frontal studio lighting contained entirely on the subject; cheerful, gentle, mischievous-cute.

Scene/backdrop: one perfectly uniform exact #00FF00 flat field, edge-to-edge, with no floor plane, gradient, noise, texture, shadow, reflection, glow, vignette, or lighting variation.
